game: Grand Theft Auto VI (released 2026-11-19, PS5 / Xbox Series)
rarity_system: GTA VI has no Common/Rare/Epic/Legendary loot ladder for guns. Weapon icons are colour-coded by OWNERSHIP: WHITE = unowned weapons scavenged from enemies or picked up in the world (temporary; can be stashed in an owned car's trunk but not registered or modded); LIGHT BLUE = owned weapons bought at Ammu-Nation (permanent, moddable, shared by Jason and Lucia, retrievable from a Weapon Locker); GOLD/YELLOW = Unique Weapon Variants: named one-off versions of a base gun with a fixed, non-modifiable build, shown in yellow in the world and in menus, permanently unlocked for BOTH protagonists once either collects one, re-equippable from any Weapon Locker, and tracked in the progress menu (not required for 100%). 'Legendary' is not an in-game tier: Sportskeeda, Beebom, Insider Gaming, KeenGamer and others use it as a synonym for the same gold unique variants. Unique variants come from four places: world finds, Illegal Operation (gang hideout) key valuables, single-store exclusives (most unlock after the Chapter 1 mission 'Gear Up' and need a bank account), and a few mission/side-mission rewards, plus Ultimate Edition signature pistols. Counts differ by site: GTABase maps 104 unique-weapon locations; Detonated says 127 variants + 2 Ultimate Edition extras (123 listed: 35 world finds, 31 Illegal Operations, 23 store-bought, 3 missions, 2 Ultimate Edition, 29 not yet found); Meowdb says about 130; Insider Gaming 'over 120'. One outlier (AOEAH tier list) claims Common green / Rare blue / Epic purple / Legendary gold tiers; no other source supports this and it contradicts the ownership colours, so treat it as wrong.
method_note: Compiled from web-search result summaries only. Direct page fetches were blocked in the research environment (gtabase.com, detonated.com and meowdb.com did not resolve; ign.com is not crawlable), and the search budget ran out before Russian/Spanish queries and the last few variants could be checked. Source URLs are the pages the search engine returned for each claim; page text was not opened directly, so quotes and per-claim attribution should be spot-checked. 'verified: true' means the search summaries showed at least two independent sites agreeing on weapon and location. Guides are only days old and several are still marked work-in-progress.

items.name: Crabshack VF5

items.how: Complete the brainwashing / time-loop puzzle inside the black site, then collect the pistol.
items.conflict: TheClick: IAA Black Site near Big Pine, North Mariana County (time-loop puzzle). Another list: Watson Bay, bunker entered by pressing a button to open a door.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный пистолет 1922. Награда за головоломку с временной петлёй («промывка мозгов») в секретном объекте IAA возле Биг-Пайн: после решения лежит у телевизора. Второй источник указывает бункер в Уотсон-Бэй.

items.name: Russo's 1922
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.landmark: President Russo's hidden bunker (President Russo world event)
items.how: Complete the President Russo world event to get into the bunker (Sportskeeda has a walkthrough with bunker codes).
items.desc_ru: Уникальный пистолет 1922 президента Руссо. Находится в его тайном бункере на острове Шарктус; попасть туда можно в ходе мирового события «Президент Руссо».
items.note: Location stated by one guide list ('President Russo's Pistol'); bunker codes exist in the Sportskeeda walkthrough but were not retrieved.

items.name: Black Eagle Import Kalinga .50
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.landmark: Black Eagle warehouse next to the Black Eagle Ammu-Nation
items.spot: In the office safe.
items.how: Read the safe code on the office computer, then open the safe.
items.conflict: One source labels the location simply 'Vice City' and mentions a door code rather than a computer-stored safe code.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный пистолет Kalinga .50. Лежит в сейфе офиса склада Black Eagle в Бальсеро; код сейфа написан на офисном компьютере.

items.name: Convict Kalinga .50
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.area: Just north of Leonida State Prison
items.spot: At the far end of an escape tunnel beneath the cabin.
items.how: Enter the tunnel under the shack; no combat needed, reachable from Port Gellhorn.
items.conflict: One guide reports the barn/entry is locked and that 'just being in Chapter 2 is not enough'; sources disagree on the entry route and when it opens.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный пистолет Kalinga .50. Лежит в конце туннеля под одинокой хижиной к северу от тюрьмы штата Леонида; бой не нужен.

items.name: Gil's Kalinga .50
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.spot: Inside the practice safe.
items.how: Open the practice safe during the Chapter 3 main mission 'Safe Word' (the safe also holds $1,500).
items.desc_ru: Уникальный пистолет Kalinga .50. Достаётся из тренировочного сейфа во время сюжетной миссии Safe Word в 3-й главе (там же $1 500).
items.note: Single source (Meowdb). Mission-bound, so likely missable, but no source states this explicitly.

items.name: Caminos Signature K17
items.rarity: unique (gold icon), Ultimate Edition exclusive
items.how: Ultimate Edition bonus (Lucia's signature pistol): claim from the Weapon Locker > Pistols > Variants.
items.chapter: From Chapter 2 / once Lucia is playable (sources differ)
items.conflict: Timing differs: 'weapon locker from Chapter 2' vs 'after gaining access to Lucia'. Sportskeeda/Showgamer still listed it as undiscovered.
items.desc_ru: Именной пистолет Люсии из Ultimate Edition. Забирается в оружейном шкафчике любого Ammu-Nation (раздел «Пистолеты» → «Варианты»).

items.name: Duval Signature ES9
items.rarity: unique (gold icon), Ultimate Edition exclusive
items.how: Ultimate Edition bonus (Jason's signature pistol): unlocked by the early Chapter 1 Ammu-Nation mission, claim from the Weapon Locker > Pistols > Variants.
items.desc_ru: Именной гравированный пистолет Джейсона из Ultimate Edition. Забирается в оружейном шкафчике любого Ammu-Nation после ранней миссии 1-й главы.

items.name: Donnie's H&L .38
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.spot: In the trunk of Donnie's car.
items.how: Open the trunk while driving to Donnie's trailer, before the car is destroyed.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный револьвер H&L .38. Лежит в багажнике красной Dinka Blista Донни во время миссии Don Gone (конец 1-й главы, Ки-Ленто). Пропускаемый: заберите до уничтожения машины.

items.name: Lyle's H&L .38
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.landmark: Old barn / abandoned shed at the dead end of a road
items.spot: In the trunk of the car inside the barn.
items.how: Free world pickup.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный револьвер H&L .38. Лежит в багажнике машины в старом сарае в тупике дороги в Бонанзе (район Амброзии).

items.name: Cargo H&L .38
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.spot: Inside the yellow container (reached by climbing and jumping across containers).
items.how: Free world pickup.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный револьвер H&L .38. Лежит в жёлтом контейнере Scoop в грузовой зоне порта Вайс-Сити; добираться нужно по крышам контейнеров.
items.note: GTABase places the Mercenary LMG 6 in a yellow Scoop container in the same cargo area; unclear whether it is the same container.

items.name: Ride Free H&L .38
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.spot: In a weapon case beneath a black flag (near the robbery safe).
items.how: Looted during the Biker Hideout robbery / Illegal Operation.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный револьвер H&L .38 байкеров. Лежит в оружейном кейсе под чёрным флагом в байкерском логове возле Амброзии (нелегальная операция).

items.name: Couch Potato Mustang .357
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.landmark: Couch hanging from a tree in front of a mobile home (Dunk's trailer) in the RV area
items.spot: Hidden inside the couch.
items.how: Shoot the ropes to drop the couch, then sit on it to find the revolver. Free.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный револьвер Mustang .357. Спрятан в диване, подвешенном на дереве перед трейлером у Тэнглвуд-лейн в Порт-Геллхорне: отстрелите верёвки и сядьте на диван.

items.name: Swamp Bait Akulus
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.area: Pelican Valley marsh, south-west of Hamlet
items.spot: On the floor in the middle of the larger waterfront building, amid the clutter a few feet from a body.
items.how: Free world pickup (same site as the Cruel Huntsman's SM-69).
items.desc_ru: Уникальный тяжёлый револьвер Akulus. Лежит на полу большого здания охотничьей хижины на болоте Пеликан-Вэлли, к юго-западу от Хэмлета; рядом — винтовка Cruel Huntsman's SM-69.

items.name: Kingfishers Akulus
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.area: North of Cottonmouth Lake, north-west of Key Lento and Gambit Bay
items.how: Looted during the Sunrise RV Park Illegal Operation.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный револьвер Akulus банды Kingfishers. Добывается во время нелегальной операции в трейлерном парке Sunrise RV Park севернее озера Коттонмаут, к северо-западу от Ки-Ленто.

items.name: Iron & Oak WCR-1
items.rarity: unique (gold icon), store-exclusive purchase
items.spot: Shop counter.
items.how: Buy for $1,260.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный компактный револьвер WCR-1. Продаётся в оружейном магазине Iron & Oak в районе Стокъярд за $1 260.
items.note: Price/location from one guide table; the GTABase page exists but its text was not retrieved.

items.name: Smuggler Gorse 425
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.landmark: Wrecked/abandoned smuggler's boat on a small island
items.spot: In the wrecked boat / on the sand next to it.
items.how: Free world pickup; reachable by boat (same trip as the Assassin Nipper .38).
items.conflict: Island differs: GTABase says 'small island east of Mile Zero Air Station, inside a wrecked smuggler's boat'; another guide says 'on the sand next to an abandoned boat on the northernmost Permit Keys island'.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный короткий дробовик Gorse 425. Лежит у разбитой лодки контрабандистов на маленьком острове Пермит-Кис; добраться можно на лодке уже в 1-й главе.

items.name: San4San Gorse 425
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.how: Key valuable of the Parlor Apartments Illegal Operation.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный дробовик Gorse 425 банды San4San. Ключевая добыча нелегальной операции Parlor Apartments в районе Рокридж (Вайс-Сити).

items.name: Basher Gorse 425
items.rarity: unique (gold icon), store-exclusive purchase
items.spot: Shop counter.
items.how: Buy at Pawn & Gun (price differs between sources).
items.conflict: Sources quote different prices; no agreed figure.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный дробовик Gorse 425. Продаётся в магазине Pawn & Gun в Порт-Геллхорне (цена в источниках расходится).

items.name: Gutterball Moreland 850
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.landmark: Kingpin Bowling (abandoned bowling alley, Illegal Operation)
items.spot: On the pool table in the games area, north-east corner of the alley.
items.how: Loot it during the 'Hit Kingpin Bowling' robbery / Illegal Operation (the nearby office safe needs sticky bombs).
items.desc_ru: Уникальный дробовик Moreland 850. Лежит на бильярдном столе в северо-восточном углу заброшенного боулинга Kingpin Bowling на юге Порт-Геллхорна (ограбление Hit Kingpin Bowling).

items.name: Final Chapter KVGA-12
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.how: Key valuable of the Irons Building Supply Illegal Operation.
items.conflict: Space4Games says it is obtained in Ambrosia during a Moses job (Western Nightblade), inside a building in the search area, rather than as the Irons Building Supply key valuable. Both place it in Ambrosia.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный автоматический дробовик KVGA-12 байкеров Final Chapter. Ключевая добыча нелегальной операции Irons Building Supply в Амброзии, юго-западнее озера Леонида.

items.name: Final Chapter Shortstraw
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.spot: Inside the garage; climb the ladder to the roof and drop in through the open hatch.
items.how: Looted during the Hog Stars Garage Illegal Operation.
items.conflict: Beebom describes the building as the one opposite Hog Stars Garage; other guides say the garage itself.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный обрез Shortstraw байкеров Final Chapter. Находится в гараже Hog Stars в Амброзии: поднимитесь по лестнице на крышу и спуститесь через открытый люк.

items.name: Unpacked Comshot 12
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.spot: Second floor, back bedroom, behind the en-suite bathroom door.
items.how: Break in; the house alarm alerts police. Free world pickup.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный боевой дробовик Comshot 12. Стоит за дверью ванной в дальней спальне второго этажа дома на северо-западном берегу Ки-Ленто. В доме сигнализация — приедет полиция.

items.name: Hellspawn Comshot 12
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.area: Mountains in the west of the county
items.landmark: Campsite with a carved wooden throne
items.spot: Appears leaning against the throne after the challenge.
items.how: Eat the offering on the throne and survive the secret 'Satan' boss encounter; reward also includes a permanent max-HP buff.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный дробовик Comshot 12 «Hellspawn». Награда за испытание в горном лагере на западе Норт-Келли: съешьте подношение на резном троне и переживите бой с секретным боссом — дробовик появится у трона.

items.name: Hostile Super400
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.spot: In a weapon case in the storage room.
items.how: Looted during the Illegal Operation; the back entrance avoids the two guards.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный дробовик Super400. Лежит в оружейном кейсе на складе радарной базы Mill Station в Грассриверс, севернее Уотсон-Бэй; тихий вход — с тыла.

items.name: Marabunta Grande Hobo
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.spot: In an open gun case on the floor of the storage building.
items.how: Go around the back of Hamlet Pawn into the storage; free pickup (cash is also there).
items.conflict: One guide describes 'an industrial storage building south of Hamlet'; another 'Hamlet Storage, behind Hamlet Pawn'. Sportskeeda still listed it as undiscovered. Space4Games writes the name as Hobo "Marabunta Grande".
items.desc_ru: Уникальный дробовик Hobo банды Marabunta Grande. Лежит в открытом оружейном кейсе на полу склада Hamlet Storage за ломбардом Hamlet Pawn в Хэмлете.

items.name: Woodhatch Longshot
items.rarity: unique (gold icon), store-exclusive purchase
items.spot: Shop counter.
items.how: Buy for $2,990.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный дробовик Longshot. Продаётся только в магазине Woodhatch в районе Капри за $2 990.
items.note: Single source (GTABase).

items.name: Cruel Huntsman's SM-69
items.class: sniper rifle (hunting rifle, Shrewsbury SM-69 variant)
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.area: Pelican Valley marsh, south-west of Hamlet
items.spot: On the boardwalk between the two buildings, beneath a hanging body.
items.how: Free world pickup (same site as the Swamp Bait Akulus).
items.conflict: Insider Gaming labels the area Gullet Marsh; others say Pelican Valley.
items.desc_ru: Уникальная охотничья снайперская винтовка SM-69. Лежит на мостках между двумя постройками охотничьей хижины на болоте Пеликан-Вэлли, под повешенным телом.

items.name: Killtelligence SM-69
items.class: sniper rifle (hunting rifle, Shrewsbury SM-69 variant)
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.landmark: Bret Vogel's hunting side mission 'Veteran Hunted'
items.how: Given by Bret during the hunting tutorial mission 'Veteran Hunted' (Chapter 2); not a map pickup.
items.desc_ru: Уникальная охотничья винтовка SM-69. Её бесплатно выдаёт Брет Фогель в начале побочной миссии «Veteran Hunted» (обучение охоте, 2-я глава).

items.name: Kingfishers Laird 350
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.area: Pelican Valley (also labelled Gullet Marsh / Grassrivers)
items.spot: In an open case in the second room - the room right after the 'tiger room'.
items.how: Kill the tiger, keep the wall on your right and go through the next open door.
items.conflict: Region label differs by source: Pelican Valley (GTABase), Gullet Marsh (Insider Gaming), Grassrivers (others). Detonated's loot-room article describes a 'legendary Laird 350 in a Hamlet motel', probably the same pickup.
items.desc_ru: Уникальная снайперская винтовка Laird 350 банды Kingfishers. Лежит в открытом кейсе в комнате сразу за «тигриной» в мотеле Manatee (нелегальная операция): убейте тигра и идите вдоль правой стены.

items.name: Hunter's Laird 350
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.landmark: Roadside random event with two hunters
items.how: Help the hunters and drive the injured one to the hospital; the rifle is the reward.
items.conflict: A GTABase map snippet attached the text 'looted during the Mill Station Radar Base Illegal Operation' to this name (that text matches the Hostile Super400, so it is probably a list mismatch). Older guides list it as undiscovered.
items.desc_ru: Уникальная снайперская винтовка Laird 350. Награда за случайное событие в болотах Грассриверс к югу от Хэмлета: отвезите раненого охотника в больницу.

items.name: Fincredible Laird 350
items.rarity: unique (gold icon), store-exclusive purchase
items.spot: Shop counter.
items.how: Buy for $2,000.
items.desc_ru: Уникальная спортивная снайперская винтовка Laird 350. Продаётся в магазине Guns Aplenty! в Уотсон-Бэй за $2 000.
items.note: Price/store from one guide table; GTABase page exists but its text was not retrieved.

items.name: Internal Affairs FF-SR
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.landmark: Tallest building on that stretch of Northside Ave (skyscraper with a helipad)
items.spot: North-west edge of the roof, near the helipad.
items.how: Reach the roof; free world pickup.
items.desc_ru: Уникальная снайперская винтовка FF-SR. Лежит на северо-западном краю крыши самого высокого здания на Нортсайд-авеню в Вашингтон-Бич (небоскрёб с вертолётной площадкой).

items.name: Kingfishers W-22
items.class: rifle (small game rifle, Wortham W-22 variant)
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.spot: In a weapon case in the main shack.
items.how: Looted during the Fishing Shacks Illegal Operation; if the area is not active yet, wait for Donnie's robbery text.
items.conflict: ScreenRant notes a few guides give slightly different spots within the Wetman Bay fishing shacks.
items.desc_ru: Уникальная мелкокалиберная винтовка W-22 банды Kingfishers. Лежит в оружейном кейсе в главной хижине рыбацких лачуг в Уэтмен-Бэй (нелегальная операция); если зона закрыта — дождитесь сообщения Донни.

items.name: Redneck W-22
items.class: rifle (small game rifle, Wortham W-22 variant)
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.landmark: Abandoned yellow train car on the north bank of the river
items.spot: Behind / at the back of the train car.
items.how: Free world pickup.
items.desc_ru: Уникальная мелкокалиберная винтовка W-22. Лежит за заброшенным жёлтым вагоном на северном берегу реки в Моро.

items.name: Mossy Mediator
items.rarity: unique (gold icon), store-exclusive purchase
items.spot: Shop counter.
items.how: Buy for $1,890 (sold only at Barrage Gun Supply).
items.conflict: Two guides place Barrage Gun Supply in Southwind; GTABase's map text says a unique weapon is 'sold only at Barrage Gun Supply in Watson Bay'.
items.desc_ru: Уникальная мелкокалиберная винтовка Mediator. Продаётся только в магазине Barrage Gun Supply за $1 890.

items.name: Gun Nut SMS-01
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.area: Key Lento, on the beach opposite a poolside bar
items.spot: In a case on the kitchen counter; go up the outside stairs.
items.how: Free world pickup.
items.desc_ru: Уникальная винтовка SMS-01. Лежит в кейсе на кухонной стойке «дома оружейного маньяка» на пляже Ки-Ленто напротив бара у бассейна; вход по наружной лестнице.
items.note: Both statements appear to come from GTABase (weapon page and map list).

items.name: Black Eagle Import M306 TMR
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.landmark: Black Eagle warehouse next to the Black Eagle Ammu-Nation
items.spot: Inside the warehouse.
items.how: Only Lucia can get in, through the garage opening.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный вариант оружия M306 TMR. Находится на складе Black Eagle рядом с одноимённым магазином в Бальсеро; попасть внутрь через гаражный проём может только Люсия.
items.note: Single source (GTABase). Same warehouse as the Black Eagle Import Kalinga .50. Weapon class not stated in the retrieved text (manufacturer Hillinger).

items.name: Guardia Brothers FRA
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.how: Looted during the Casa Guardia Illegal Operation.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный вариант оружия FRA братьев Гуардия. Добывается во время нелегальной операции Casa Guardia в северо-восточном углу Литл-Кубы.
items.note: Clearly attributed to GTABase only; a second guide appears to repeat it but could not be confirmed. Weapon class not stated in the retrieved text (manufacturer ADB).

items.name: Darknite Drifter
items.rarity: unique (gold icon), store-exclusive purchase
items.spot: Shop counter.
items.how: Buy for $2,420.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный вариант оружия Shrewsbury Drifter. Продаётся в оружейном магазине на северо-западной окраине Порт-Геллхорна за $2 420.
items.note: Base weapon appears to be the Shrewsbury Drifter; weapon class not stated in the retrieved text.

items.name: Mercenary LMG 6
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.area: Northern part of the Port Vice City cargo area
items.spot: Inside the yellow container.
items.how: Approach from the water, climb the ladder, jump from the blue container to the beige one and break into the yellow one to avoid the guards.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный ручной пулемёт LMG 6. Лежит в жёлтом контейнере Scoop в северной части грузовой зоны порта Вайс-Сити: зайдите с воды, поднимитесь по лестнице и перепрыгните с синего контейнера на бежевый.

items.name: Shark Knife
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.area: Sea north of the Saint Attaway Islands
items.landmark: Shark cage in an underwater ravine
items.spot: Stuck in the seabed next to the shark cage.
items.how: Dive; free world pickup.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный боевой нож. Воткнут в морское дно рядом с клеткой для акул в подводном ущелье к северу от островов Сент-Аттауэй.

items.name: Explorer's Knife
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.area: Emerald River underwater cave system, west of Emerald Springs
items.spot: Deep inside the underwater cave system.
items.how: Enter via Selkie Hole; scuba gear and a flashlight are provided there (one guide: pick up the scuba gear at the stairs in the cave).
items.conflict: Guides vary: 'deep in the Emerald River cave system via Selkie Hole' vs 'hidden inside Selkie Hole, west of Emerald Springs' vs simply 'Ambrosia'.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный нож исследователя. Спрятан глубоко в подводной системе пещер реки Эмералд; вход через Селки-Хоул, акваланг и фонарь выдаются на месте.

items.name: Soldier's Combat Knife
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.area: West shore between Bobcat Bight and Bobcat Key
items.spot: Inside the tank's hatch.
items.how: Reachable at low tide; free world pickup.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный боевой нож. Лежит в люке полузатопленного танка на западном берегу между Бобкэт-Байт и Бобкэт-Ки; добраться можно во время отлива.
items.note: Only Metaforge could be attributed with certainty.

items.name: Tallaloko Knife
items.rarity: unique (gold icon); called 'legendary' by several guides
items.spot: Behind the locked door on the second floor; the lockbox there also holds $7,000+ of jewellery.
items.how: Solve the Tallaloko Hotel puzzle to open the locked door.
items.desc_ru: Уникальный боевой нож. Лежит за запертой дверью на втором этаже хижины «Evergreen» на западном берегу озера Таллалоко (головоломка отеля Таллалоко); там же украшения на $7 000+.
items.note: Both statements appear to come from GTABase (weapon page and map list).

items.name: Brontasaurus Bat

known_gaps: Roughly 55-60 of the ~127 unique variants are still missing here: mainly the rest of the ~23 store exclusives, several Illegal Operation key valuables, and the ~29 variants no guide had located yet.
GTABase's separate 'Weapon Pickup Locations (55)' layer (ordinary free guns, explosives, melee) could not be read: https://www.gtabase.com/gta-6/map/?feature=weapon-spawn

Insider Gaming 'Best Secret Gear Spot in GTA 6 Early Game - Insane Rifle, Grenade Launcher, and More' (https://insider-gaming.com/best-secret-loot-location-early-game-gta-6/) and Detonated 'Secret Loot Rooms' were not read.
Safe/door code values for La Polilla Negra KZ-59 (Beebom), Black Eagle warehouse and the President Russo bunkers (Sportskeeda) were not retrieved.

ScreenRant mentions store exclusives at Zenon's Pawn Shop and Biff's Gun Supply and a unique from the Chapter 3 mission 'Cooties'; GTABase mentions one sold at an Ammu-Nation in Vice Beach. Names not retrieved.
No map coordinates are available from text sources; positions must be taken from an interactive map (GTABase, Dexerto, grandleonida.com, vice6map.com, gta6map.io).
